basics.title: Glad you're here.
basics.subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself.

photosStep.title: Show yourself.
photosStep.subtitle: 3 to 5 photos — 2 are enough to start. Important: the first photo shows your face.

aboutStep.title: About you.
aboutStep.subtitle: A sentence or two is plenty — how you are, not your CV.
aboutStep.placeholder: e.g. Half gym, half croissants. Always up for plans worth telling stories about.

promptsStep.title: Two questions, honest answers.
promptsStep.subtitle: Pick two questions and answer in your own words. A third one is optional.

locationStep.title: Where's home?
locationStep.subtitle: Just a neighbourhood, town or postcode — never your address.
locationStep.privacyHint: Others only ever see this label — never an address or exact distance.

interestsStep.title: What do you already love doing?

firstPlan.title: Create your first plan.
firstPlan.subtitle: Where are you going this week anyway? Invite someone along.
firstPlan.laterHint: No pressure — you can create a plan any time.

intent.intentHint: These two settings steer everything: you only see what fits you — and vice versa.
intent.categoriesHint: Categories only sort your feed — nobody is ever excluded.
intent.orientHint: Only steers your Discover set — visible to no one.
intent.relHint: What's true for you — not what you're looking for. Only appears as a small badge if you set it. Tap again to remove.

me.radiusHint: Sorts by distance — never excludes anyone. Others only see your place, never your address or exact distance.
